NET.6: Set me like a cylinder seal over your heart, like a signet on your arm. For love is as strong as death, passion is as unrelenting as Sheol. Its flames burst forth, it is a blazing flame.
NET.7: Surging waters cannot quench love; floodwaters cannot overflow it. If someone were to offer all his possessions to buy love, the offer would be utterly despised.
NET.8: We have a little sister, and as yet she has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister on the day when she is spoken for?
NET.9: If she is a wall, we will build on her a battlement of silver; but if she is a door, we will barricade her with boards of cedar.
NET.10: I was a wall, and my breasts were like fortress towers. Then I found favor in his eyes.
NET.11: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-Hamon; he leased out the vineyard to those who maintained it. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.
NET.12: My vineyard, which belongs to me, is at my disposal alone. The thousand shekels belong to you, O Solomon, and two hundred shekels belong to those who maintain it for its fruit.
NET.13: O you who stay in the gardens, my companions are listening attentively for your voice; let me be the one to hear it!
NET.14: Make haste, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices.
